skills.name: Absolute Obedience
skills.description: Changes into Zero's outfit  and activates his Geass.  *Skill Evade Rate +30% (10 sec) *Allies' Skill Range +30% (10 sec)

skills.name: D.C.P.T.Cannon
skills.description: Summons the Shinkiro.  Fires the Diffusion Composition  Phase Transition Cannon.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *Continuously cancels enemy buffs (4 sec) *Makes enemy skills unusable (7 sec) *ATK x 4400% Area Damage

abilities.name: Group: CODE GEASS Lelouch of the Rebellion
abilities.description: CODE GEASS Lelouch of the Rebellion Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle.  You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy Stun: Strength
abilities.description: Has a high chance of stunning all Strength type enemies and canceling their invincibility skill effects when Rangers deploy. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 6 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
